_description: Invariant manifest for EESS Non-Authorizing Prototype v0.3.24. Each entry declares one invariant, its falsification condition, and the test classes that exercise it.

invariants.name: Append-only journal
invariants.falsification_condition: An event already committed to the journal is observed to have changed its payload, hash, or position after commit.

invariants.name: Predecessor-linked integrity chain
invariants.falsification_condition: A tampered event passes verify_head() without detection (including chain-break detection via prev_hash linkage), or a valid untampered journal fails verify_head().

invariants.name: Deterministic reducer
invariants.falsification_condition: Two calls to reduce() on the same verified journal snapshot produce different SafetyState values.

invariants.name: Atomic dispatch claim
invariants.falsification_condition: Two concurrent threads both succeed in committing a J2 for the same decision_id + attempt_id, or a J2 is committed while the reducer reports a non-PENDING state.

invariants.name: Temporal J11 ordering
invariants.falsification_condition: A J11 reconciliation event is accepted when its append_offset is not strictly greater than the latest J4c append_offset for the same attempt.

invariants.name: Canonical-copy ownership boundary (deepcopy eliminated)
invariants.falsification_condition: Mutating an event dict after ingestion changes the stored journal entry, or mutating a returned event dict changes the journal. v0.3.20: _canonicalize_payload() replaces copy.deepcopy() for J0 ingestion -- builds a plain built-in dict from scratch rather than invoking attacker-controlled __deepcopy__ hooks.

invariants.name: Universal integrity guard on typed mutators
invariants.falsification_condition: A typed mutator (record_j0 through record_j12) accepts an event and commits it to a journal whose integrity chain is already broken.

invariants.name: Status readers verify integrity or fail closed
invariants.falsification_condition: get_attempt_outcome(), has_conflict(), has_j2(), or get_attempts() returns a definitive status on a tampered journal instead of None, True (for has_conflict), False (for has_j2), or empty list.

invariants.name: Verified snapshot for reducer consumption
invariants.falsification_condition: DecisionReducer.reduce() returns a non-QUARANTINED result when fed a journal with a broken integrity chain.

invariants.name: J11 target_transaction_id strict string validation
invariants.falsification_condition: record_reconciliation_evidence() accepts a non-string, None, or whitespace-only target_transaction_id without raising ValueError.

invariants.name: Validate-then-mutate fencing
invariants.falsification_condition: A rejected mock request (empty hash, whitespace key, missing field) advances _seen_epochs, _seen_keys, or _seen_effects, blocking a subsequent valid request that should succeed.

invariants.name: Strict integer epoch type
invariants.falsification_condition: MockTarget.call() accepts a float (1.0), bool (True), or negative integer as epoch without returning DEFINITIVE_NO_EFFECT.

invariants.name: SHA-256 grammar validation via regex
invariants.falsification_condition: A string that is not exactly 64 hex characters passes _validate_sha256(), or a valid 64-hex-char string is rejected.

invariants.name: Mock input completeness
invariants.falsification_condition: MockTarget.call() accepts a direct call with missing decision_id, whitespace-only idempotency_key, whitespace-only request_hash, boolean request_hash, or mismatched target without typed refusal.

invariants.name: Validate-then-commit event construction
invariants.falsification_condition: A typed mutator partially mutates journal state and then raises an exception, leaving the journal in a half-committed state.

invariants.name: Decision-id format validation
invariants.falsification_condition: A typed mutator accepts an empty, whitespace-only, or non-string decision_id without raising ValueError.

invariants.name: J4 strict outcome types
invariants.falsification_condition: record_target_effect_confirmed() or record_no_effect() accepts an evidence_hash or payload that is not a valid string, or accepts a disallowed outcome type.

invariants.name: Capability enum validation
invariants.falsification_condition: An adapter is constructed with a capability value not in VALID_CAPABILITIES, or a journal accepts a J1 with an unrecognized capability string.

invariants.name: Reconciliation trust boundary
invariants.falsification_condition: The test-only reconciliation helper directly authorizes a definitive J4a/J4b without going through the dispatch engine's eligibility check.

invariants.name: J4c blocked after definitive outcome
invariants.falsification_condition: record_target_effect_unknown() succeeds on an attempt that already has a definitive J4a or J4b.

invariants.name: Retention validation
invariants.falsification_condition: DispatchEngine accepts a dedup_retention_seconds that is NaN, Inf, negative, zero, boolean, or non-numeric without raising ValueError.

invariants.name: Adapter retention required for dispatch
invariants.falsification_condition: DispatchEngine.dispatch() proceeds to target call without a registered adapter for the decision's target_id.

invariants.name: Query scope correctness
invariants.falsification_condition: get_attempts() for decision D returns attempts belonging to a different decision D', or get_attempt_outcome() for (D, ATT) returns the outcome of a different attempt.

invariants.name: Lease ownership binding
invariants.falsification_condition: A dispatch proceeds after the lease has expired, or a second dispatch for the same attempt succeeds while an unexpired lease is held.

invariants.name: J12 effect binding and deduplication
invariants.falsification_condition: A J12 is committed without binding to a prior J2 attempt_id, or a duplicate J12 for the same effect_id is accepted.

invariants.name: Malformed target response handling
invariants.falsification_condition: _parse_target_response() accepts a None, non-tuple, wrong-length tuple, or non-string-field response without raising ValueError.

invariants.name: J11 query_result validation
invariants.falsification_condition: record_reconciliation_evidence() accepts a non-string or empty query_result without raising ValueError.

invariants.name: Mock request-key dedup binding
invariants.falsification_condition: MockTarget dedup replay returns the same tx_id for a request whose effect_id or request_hash differs from the original, without signaling a conflict.

invariants.name: Predecessor-linked hash chain
invariants.falsification_condition: Rewriting an earlier event payload and recomputing only its hash does not cause verify_head() to return False. Or: event at offset N has prev_hash that does not match the integrity_hash of event at offset N-1.

invariants.name: Fail-closed on J3 integrity failure
invariants.falsification_condition: After record_attempt_observed() raises due to journal corruption, target.call() is invoked and target.call_count > 0.

invariants.name: Post-J3 authorization interlock (snapshot-scoped)
invariants.falsification_condition: Authorization state is non-VALID (REVOKED, EXPIRED, or other) at the post-J3 reducer snapshot AND target.call_count > 0. Note: revocation/expiration interleaved AFTER the snapshot and BEFORE target.call() is a known residual TOCTOU race, not covered by this contract.

invariants.name: Canonical SHA-256 grammar on all hash fields
invariants.falsification_condition: Any hash-valued field in any J-event type accepts a value that does not match re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{64}", value). Includes J4a evidence_hash, J12 competing_evidence_hash, and request_hash.

invariants.name: Positive authorization predicate at post-J3 gate
invariants.falsification_condition: Post-J3 gate checks for a specific non-VALID state (e.g. == REVOKED) instead of requiring == VALID. Any non-VALID state that reaches the post-J3 gate without blocking dispatch falsifies this.

invariants.name: Quarantine check at post-J3 gate
invariants.falsification_condition: Reducer reports SafetyState.QUARANTINED at the post-J3 gate AND target.call_count > 0.

invariants.name: Detectable-corruption monotonicity (narrowed NC-P2)
invariants.falsification_condition: Detectable corruption (hash chain inconsistency) of any event does NOT cause the reducer to return QUARANTINED. Note: consistent suffix truncation is a KNOWN LIMITATION documented by TestNCP2SuffixTruncationAwareness, not covered by I-6.

invariants.name: Positive-path lifecycle completion
invariants.falsification_condition: A valid dispatch with healthy journal and confirming mock target does not produce CONFIRMED, or target.call_count != 1, or reducer does not reach TERMINAL_CONFIRMED.

invariants.name: BSSG five-conjunct diagnostic accuracy (corrected truth conditions)
invariants.falsification_condition: BSSG diagnostic reports TRUE for a conjunct without positive supporting evidence. v0.3.16: contract_match also checks J0 action against ALLOWED_ACTIONS. effect_type_valid UNKNOWN without J2, target_allowed always UNKNOWN.

invariants.name: J0 action vocabulary freeze
invariants.falsification_condition: commit_decision() or reserve_effect_and_commit_decision() accepts an action value not in ALLOWED_ACTIONS, or a J0 with forbidden action reaches dispatch. v0.3.16: enforced at journal boundary (C-33) and dispatch boundary (defense in depth).

invariants.name: Journal-level action vocabulary enforcement
invariants.falsification_condition: reserve_effect_and_commit_decision() accepts an action value not in ALLOWED_ACTIONS without raising ValueError.

invariants.name: Exact built-in str action enforcement
invariants.falsification_condition: A str subclass with spoofed __eq__/__hash__ passes action validation, or type(action) is not str passes any action check.

invariants.name: Systematic exact built-in str enforcement
invariants.falsification_condition: Any public journal mutator (J0-J12) or dispatch boundary accepts a str subclass with overridden __eq__/__hash__, or type(value) is not str passes validation at any authoritative boundary. v0.3.19: systematic closure across ALL 14 journal mutators. v0.3.20: _canonicalize_payload coerces J0 payload subclass values to plain built-in types; J7/filter boundaries hardened. v0.3.22: subclass values rejected outright -- no coercion hooks invoked.

invariants.name: Canonical payload enforcement (P17 deepcopy elimination)
invariants.falsification_condition: A dict subclass with __deepcopy__ hook, a str subclass key, or a str subclass value in J0 payload passes validation or is stored without coercion to exact built-in types. Or: copy.deepcopy() is invoked on attacker-controlled input.

invariants.name: J7 lease expiration exact-type guards
invariants.falsification_condition: expire_lease() accepts a str subclass target, int subclass epoch, or non-positive epoch without raising ValueError. Or: lease comparison/indexing occurs before exact-type validation.

invariants.name: Verified query filter exact-type enforcement
invariants.falsification_condition: verified_snapshot() or get_events() accepts a decision_id filter that is a str subclass with custom __eq__, allowing attacker-controlled equality to widen query scope.

invariants.name: Exact-type contract validation (polymorphic dispatch eliminated)
invariants.falsification_condition: A TargetContract subclass with overridden supports_automated_dispatch() bypasses the capability safety gate, or dispatch() evaluates capability policy via a virtual method on a caller-supplied object rather than using a canonical local value.

invariants.name: Exact-type numeric retention validation
invariants.falsification_condition: An int or float subclass with overridden __float__, __le__, or __lt__ bypasses dedup_retention_seconds validation, allowing zero, negative, or non-finite retention to pass _validate_retention() or adapter-vs-contract comparison.

invariants.name: Fully recursive payload canonicalization (subclass rejection)
invariants.falsification_condition: A value nested at any depth in a list or dict within J0 payload retains a subclass __deepcopy__, __eq__, __hash__, __int__, __str__, or __float__ hook after _canonicalize_payload(). Or: any subclass of str/int/float/bool/list/dict passes through _canonicalize_value() without raising ValueError. v0.3.22: subclass coercion removed; all non-exact-built-in types rejected outright.

invariants.name: TOCTOU-safe contract snapshot
invariants.falsification_condition: Any contract property is read from the target_contract object more than once in dispatch() after the initial snapshot block, or any value used for authorization, hashing, or J2 recording is sourced from a live object reference rather than a canonical local variable.

invariants.name: Overflow-safe integer retention validation
invariants.falsification_condition: An exact built-in int value for dedup_retention_seconds causes OverflowError, uncaught exception, or any outcome other than a typed BLOCKED DispatchResult when passed to _validate_retention() or compared with adapter retention.

invariants.name: Lock-safe input canonicalization (no subclass hooks under lock)
invariants.falsification_condition: _canonicalize_value() or _canonicalize_payload() invokes any Python dunder method (__int__, __str__, __float__, __bool__, __iter__, __deepcopy__, __eq__, __hash__) on a non-exact-built-in-type value while the journal lock is held, or any subclass of str/int/float/bool/list/dict passes through canonicalization without raising ValueError.

invariants.name: Backing-store capability drift detection (pre-J2)
invariants.falsification_condition: A MockTarget subclass whose capability property getter mutates its backing _capability attribute while returning the approved value causes dispatch() to commit J2 or call target.call() after the mutation. Or: the backing-store inspection via vars(target) fails to detect the drift.

invariants.name: Hook-free diagnostic messages under lock
invariants.falsification_condition: _canonicalize_payload() or _canonicalize_value() formats, reprs, strs, or otherwise invokes a dunder on a rejected non-built-in key or value while the journal lock is held, allowing attacker __format__/__repr__/__str__ to re-enter the lock.

invariants.name: Cycle-aware depth-bounded payload canonicalization
invariants.falsification_condition: A self-referential list or dict in J0 payload causes RecursionError instead of ValueError, or nesting beyond _MAX_CANONICALIZE_DEPTH passes canonicalization without raising ValueError.

invariants.name: Hook-free diagnostics in all lock-bearing paths (metaclass-safe)
invariants.falsification_condition: Any lock-bearing path in the journal accesses type(x).__name__ or any other attribute on a rejected non-built-in type object, allowing a metaclass __getattribute__ hook to execute and re-enter the journal lock.

invariants.name: Aggregate canonicalization resource limits
invariants.falsification_condition: A payload with more than _MAX_CANONICALIZE_NODES expanded nodes, a single primitive larger than _MAX_PRIMITIVE_BYTES, or total payload larger than _MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES passes _canonicalize_payload() without raising ValueError.

invariants.name: Target-side capability enforcement (no request override)
invariants.falsification_condition: A caller-provided _authorized_capability field in the request dict causes MockTarget.call() to use a capability different from its construction-time _init_capability, allowing fencing to be downgraded to dedup semantics by an untrusted request.
